common.wordmark: M A T T E R H O R N
boundary.title: This part could not be drawn.
boundary.body: Nothing else on the page is affected. Reload to try it again.
hello.sub: Most people see the peak. The Matterhorn shows the journey and its impact.
lang.title: Choose your app language
lang.body: UI and narration language only. Your news regions come next.
regions.title: Which news do you care about?
regions.body: Pick any. Regions set which Country Packs feed your Radar: they never tune the analysis to you.
notif.title: One alert a day, at most.
notif.body: Push exists to beat a rising narrative to you, never to be its courier. Copy leads with what the story omits. A raw hot headline is never forwarded to your lock screen.
notif.preview.title: New dissection · Indonesia
notif.preview.body: Stop MBG to save the budget · missing link · 3 missing links · 4 hidden stakeholders
sheet.ios.title: “Matterhorn” Would Like to Send You Notifications
sheet.ios.body: One per day at most. Quiet hours respected.
toast.notif.on: Radar will beat the narrative to you: once a day, at most
auth.title: Keep your progress.
auth.body: An account only syncs your scaffolding level across devices. The analysis pipeline never sees who you are: stance-blindness is architecture, not a promise.
auth.footer.a: Analysis is computed once, for everyone.
toast.no.account: Reading without an account: nothing is tracked
sheet.auth.title: About accounts
sheet.auth.body: Account sync ships with the store build; the demo runs fully on-device. Nothing you do here is transmitted anywhere.
radar.footer: Served from cache. No model on the read path.
radar.empty: This pack carries no feed in this build yet.
radar.region.body: Feeds are pre-computed per Country Pack: switching is instant, from cache.
radar.review.title: Open corrections
radar.review.body: An entry stays open while the figure is re-read. Corrections publish with the same prominence as the original, with a public changelog.
radar.crisis.title: Radar holds during active crises
radar.crisis.body: West Java flash flooding: first hours. Dissection of crisis rumor streams could interfere with emergency response, so Radar holds and official channels render instead.
toast.region.cache: Rendered from cache, pre-computed per pack
toast.outbound: Opens {url}: traffic out, never a rating
dissect.title: Dissect
dissect.body: Any link or text, from anywhere. Two taps from the scene of exposure.
dissect.paste.hint: Paste a link, or the text of a claim
dissect.another.title: From another app
dissect.another.body: Matterhorn registers as a share target. From a chat, a feed, anywhere: share a link and the claim map opens.
dissect.another.cta: Try it: open the family chat →
dissect.recent.none: Nothing has been resolved on this device yet.
dissect.foot: Cache-first. One reader’s question becomes everyone’s answer.
rate.title: Daily fresh-dissection limit reached
rate.body: Fresh (uncached) dissections are limited to 2 per day at demo scale: frontier-model analysis is the only expensive step. Cached dissections stay unlimited, and one user’s question becomes everyone’s answer.
prog.honest: Fresh dissections usually take up to 3 minutes. This demo compresses the wait.
prog.s0.sub: The article, and the family of articles carrying the same skeleton.
prog.s1.sub: Each figure is matched to a dated primary source, or it does not render.
prog.s2.sub: The lean spread is checked before a sentence is written.
prog.s3.sub: Computed once, for everyone who reaches this link next.
toast.dissect.cached: Served from the shared cache · computed {at}
toast.dissect.joined: Cached for everyone: it joined the {pack} feed
toast.updated: Republished from research mode: this dissection carries a newer run
chat.m0: This is why everything costs more now. 12 percent on everything from next month.
chat.m1: Wait. I read this morning that it only reaches a short list of goods?
chat.hint: Tap the share arrow on the forwarded link
share.sim.title: Kemenkeu rilis aturan PPN 12 persen hanya untuk barang mewah
share.sim.foot: Two taps from the scene of exposure
toast.share.sim: The simulation carries one destination: the claim map
archive.title: Archive
archive.body: A citable public record of how a country argued with itself.
archive.const.title: Constellation · shared nodes
archive.const.foot: A compact teaser. The full graph is the desktop research surface.
archive.foot: A stable permalink per dissection. Export ships with the research build.
settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Verdict-free by design. The reader stays the judge.
settings.scaffold.auto.body: Adaptive: full sparring (S3) on a first-seen narrative, the prediction tap (S1) as your reading holds, the direct view (S0) as the success state.
settings.scaffold.override: Demo override active: every dissection opens at {level}.
settings.scaffold.foot: Computed on this device; it never leaves your phone. Applied strictly after the stance-blind analysis is already computed: the only personalization in the product. Demoted gently after 21 idle days, and never announced as a failure.
settings.disclosure.why: Analyzed-by and narrated-by chips render on every card, expandable to the full chain. Model branding is never a rigor signal: what a reader sees instead is grounding depth, identical in kind on every card.
settings.about.why: Two modes on one spine: Radar intercepts a rising narrative, Dissect answers a two-tap share. Descriptive counts only, and no verdicts anywhere.
install.title: Install Matterhorn to your home screen and it appears straight in your share sheet.
frame.caption: Matterhorn is a phone app. What runs here is the same app, at phone size.
frame.install.body: Open this page on a phone and choose Add to Home Screen. The installed app receives shared links straight from the share sheet.
notif.settings.foot: Push exists to beat a narrative to you, so it must never become its courier. Notification copy leads with the dissection. No template can interpolate a raw headline as its first line.
notif.tpl.title: New dissection · {pack}
notif.tpl.empty: No dissection is on file for this pack yet.
toast.notif.blocked: Notifications are switched off for this site, so nothing was sent.
meth.symmetry.body: Every published dissection carries a lean, assigned before a sentence is written. The receipt is the spread across the whole archive.
autopsy.title: Autopsy · {pack}
autopsy.prov: Grounded in {sources} sources · the full chain ⌄
autopsy.tag.why: Technique tags come from a locked vocabulary, reviewed per pack. A tag names the move in the story, never the person who made it.
autopsy.chain.title: The authoring chain
autopsy.chain.body: The slots that produced this artifact, then the two gates that judged it before it could publish.
autopsy.chain.foot: Input contract: narrative cluster and pack id. No user id, no history, no locale of person. Anti-sycophancy is a property of the data flow, not a prompt.
spar.foot: Sparring runs on this device. Nothing about your answers leaves it.
spar.diff.title: You called {hits} of {total} before the reveal.
spar.diff.pred.title: Your prediction, before the reveal.
orig.foot: Narration is generated directly in the target language from the evidence graph, never translated after the fact. The headline above is quoted for identification and links out to the outlet.
explore.title: Explore
explore.body: Panels beyond the visible five live here: the cap keeps the story readable.
explore.constellation.body: The nodes this narrative shares with others on file open in the Archive.
toast.denominator: Denominator switching ships with the research build
flag.title: Flag this dissection
flag.body: Open to any outlet or named actor, and to you.
flag.r0: Factual error in a sourced number
flag.done.title: Received.
flag.done.body: An “under review” chip appears within 24 hours. Corrections publish with the same prominence as the original, with a public changelog.
nuance.hidden: + {n} hidden branches the headline priced at zero
nuance.note.a: The needle ships with the bait. Counts travel with the headline, always.
nuance.note.b: No verdict language anywhere on the asset.
toast.nuance.saved: Saved: the deep link opens this exact dissection
toast.nuance.share: Sharing the structure, not the rage
toast.nuance.failed: The card did not render, and nothing was saved.
queue.title: Queued to the private agent fleet
queue.body: This link is new to the archive. Fresh dissections are produced by the editorial fleet and land in the next cycle. Nothing is invented in the meantime.
route.notfound.title: No such page
route.notfound.body: That address is not part of Matterhorn.
route.offline.title: Offline
route.offline.body: You are offline and this page is not in the cache yet. Everything already opened stays readable.
route.share.title: Shared link
share.resolved: This link resolves to {id} by {match} match. The dissection opens.
share.miss: This link is not in the archive. The queue state opens.
autopsy.chain.gates.note: A gate token signs the rows above, and the gates run after they are stamped, so the models that judged are recorded in the committed run log rather than in this artifact.
research.title: Research mode
research.body: The whole archive as a table, the full constellation, and one dissection at a time in the rail. Every figure on this page is a count of published records.
research.untested: {n} kept and marked: a filter could not read {fields} on them, and a filter that cannot read a field does not get to drop a row.
research.graph.label: Constellation. Drag to pan and scroll to zoom. Arrow keys pan, plus and minus zoom, zero resets the view.
research.graph.caption: {nodes} points · {links} shared nodes
research.graph.orphans: {n} points carry no dissection in the loaded packs. They stay drawn, and no filter tests them.
research.graph.nodeless: {n} dissections carry no point in the constellation.
research.rail.title: Detail
research.rail.empty: Pick a row or a point to open its detail.
research.rail.orphan: No dissection in the loaded packs carries this point, so the rail can only show what the graph itself holds.
research.rail.velocity.nospan: Fewer than two outlets carry a date precise to the day, so no span is stated.
research.rail.velocity.coarse: {n} of {outlets} outlets carry a month and not a day.
research.rail.spread.note: Counted over the {n} dissections the filters kept, from the lean each one publishes.
research.rail.spread.untested: {n} with no lean in the loaded packs
research.export.note: Built in this browser from published content and matching the filters above: {nodes} points and {links} links. Nothing is sent anywhere.
research.narrow.title: Research mode wants a wider screen
research.narrow.body: This surface puts an archive table, the whole constellation and a detail rail side by side. On a screen this narrow they stack into a very long page, and the constellation gets too small to follow a link across. Matterhorn for phones is the app: the same dissections, the same evidence sheets, laid out for a thumb.
research.narrow.foot: Continuing is fine. Nothing here is kept from you; it is only laid out for a desk.
research.col.head: Headline
research.replay.title: Editorial run replay
research.replay.label: Fleet replay for {id}
research.replay.refix: The candidate went back, was refixed, and returned to the gates.
research.replay.scan: Scan to open this dissection on your phone. It arrives flagged as just published.
